subject: conversion-target-currency
detail: Tallyho converts foreign receipts to the user's home currency (documented), but its shared budget totals are in one budget currency (screenshot: EUR). Members of one budget can have different home currencies, so 'home currency' totals would disagree between members. Spendly records no currency at all.
solutions: Convert to the budget's currency for the expense and its totals; keep the original amount and currency
Convert to each viewer's home currency at display time
No conversion: reject expenses not in the budget currency
recommended: Convert to the budget's currency, store original amount, currency, rate and rate date; every member sees the same totals

subject: scanned-expense-category
detail: Tallyho's scan fills merchant, date and total but no category is documented; Spendly rejects any expense without a known category. A scanned receipt would either fail to save or need a silent default.
solutions: Require the user to pick a category on the review screen before saving
Guess a category from the merchant
recommended: Require a category on the review screen (no silent default); Spendly's rule stays intact

subject: access-after-member-removal
detail: Tallyho documents that the owner can remove members, and the user saw that a removed member's earlier expenses stay in the budget; whether the removed member can still see the budget is not known. Left unclear, a removed person might keep seeing everyone's spending.
solutions: Keep their expenses in the budget, end their access at once
Delete or move their expenses out of the budget on removal
Let them keep read access to their own past expenses
recommended: Keep their expenses (totals stay correct, as in Tallyho) and end all their access to the budget at once

subject: monthly-reset-meaning
detail: 'Budgets reset monthly' does not say what resets, on which day or in which time zone.
solutions: Calendar-month period in the budget's time zone; spent counts expenses dated in it; nothing deleted
recommended: Calendar-month period in the budget's time zone, by expense date; nothing deleted

subject: expense-currency-missing-in-b
detail: Spendly expenses have no currency or date; Tallyho expenses need both.
solutions: Currency defaults to the budget currency and date to today when not given
Make both required on every entry
recommended: Default currency to the budget currency and date to today in the entry form; both stored as required columns
